security: Raw provider credentials, authorization headers, cookies and session tokens must never appear in responses or receipts.
The bridge must reject publish, deploy, payment, purchase, account mutation and external-message work.
Systemia admission remains authoritative; Raven may execute only the admitted work packet.
Provider completion is not proof of factual correctness. External factual claims require evidence references.
Base44 is not an allowed transport, credential store, execution runtime or fallback for this bridge.
